Amazon Great Indian Festival Sees Shopping Volumes Double

The Amazon Great Indian Festival in 2026 experienced a doubling of shopping volumes compared to the previous year. The event also featured fashion trends, with 10 stylish Indian wear sets available for under ₹2,000.
